assertions.name: argmax_chi_not_canonical
assertions.source: argmax-χ angle order ≠ SO(3)-tower appearance order

description: Convergence test for the keystone fibre map. The argmax-χ candidate angle order and the canonical SO(3)-tower appearance order DISAGREE, so argmax-χ is a heuristic, not canonical: the irrep→angle map is not determined by elementary icosahedral combinatorics and needs the Bring-equivariant identity. argmax-χ recorded as conj:s5-so3-argmax-chi-fibre (NOT wired).
caveats: Negative/structural result: no convergent canonical irrep→angle map from elementary icosahedral combinatorics (tower + character disagree). The map needs the deeper Bring-equivariant identity. Nothing wired; the BringFiberAction class stays without an instance (genuinely conditional).
